description: Implementation of the mobility_manager class handling handover procedures, intra- and inter-cell handovers, and related operations in a 3GPP-compliant network environment.

classes.name: mobility_manager
classes.description: Class managing mobility procedures including handovers and conditional handovers.

methods.name: trigger_handover
methods.description: Initiates a handover to a target PCI for a given UE identified by source PCI and RNTI.

methods.name: trigger_conditional_handover
methods.description: Prepares and triggers a conditional handover with specified target PCIs and timeout.

methods.name: handle_conditional_handover
methods.description: Handles the preparation of a conditional handover, including validation and context setup.

methods.name: handle_neighbor_better_than_spcell
methods.description: Handles event when a neighbor cell is better than the serving cell, possibly triggering handover.

methods.name: handle_handover
methods.description: Performs handover procedure, either intra- or inter-cell, based on target DU availability.

methods.name: handle_intra_cu_handover
methods.description: Handles intra-CU handover request to a specific target DU.

methods.name: handle_inter_cu_handover
methods.description: Handles inter-CU handover, involving NGAP signaling and PDU session transfer.
